hook.line: On official papers nothing simply starts or stops. When Altamira's lawyer reads the notice to the neighbours, a session gets a *comienzo* and a conflict gets a *fin*.
hook.es: La presidenta dio comienzo a la sesión.

examples.es: El acuerdo puso fin a la huelga.
examples.en: The agreement put an end to the strike.

examples.es: La presidenta dio comienzo a la sesión.
La junta dio comienzo a la asamblea a las nueve.
examples.en: The board began the assembly at nine.
Let's put an end to this discussion.

examples.es: El tribunal puso fin al caso.
examples.en: The court put an end to the case.

rule:
This is the formal way to say begin and end. *Dar comienzo a* = begin. *Poner fin a* = end.

The noun does the work (*comienzo*, *fin*) and the verb just changes: *dio comienzo*, *darán comienzo*, *puso fin*, *pongamos fin*. What you start or stop follows *a* (*al* before *el*): *puso fin al caso*. The event itself can also be the subject, with no *a*: *mañana darán comienzo los actos*.

It sounds like a ceremony or a statute, and English "commence" and "bring to an end" sound the same way. Among friends, use *empezar* and *terminar*.
smallPrint: Teachers call these light-verb phrases: a common verb plus a noun doing the job of one verb.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *comienzo* or *fin*: La presidenta dio ___ a la sesión. (She began it.) Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: La presidenta dio comienzo a la sesión.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *comienzo* or *fin*: El acuerdo puso ___ a la huelga. (It ended it.) Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: El acuerdo puso fin a la huelga.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *a* or *al*: El tribunal puso fin ___ caso. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: El tribunal puso fin al caso.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: The board began the assembly at nine.
yourTurn.answer: La junta dio comienzo a la asamblea a las nueve.
yourTurn.why: *Dio comienzo a* + the thing you begin.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: Let's put an end to this discussion.
Make it about the future: *La junta dio comienzo a la asamblea.*
yourTurn.answer: La junta dará comienzo a la asamblea.

yourTurn.prompt: Turn it around so it ends: *El alcalde dio comienzo a la ceremonia.*
yourTurn.answer: El alcalde puso fin a la ceremonia.
yourTurn.why: *Poner fin a* is the opposite of *dar comienzo a*.

pitfalls.why: Almost. What starts needs *a* in front of it.

pitfalls.wrong: El acuerdo puso fin de la huelga.
pitfalls.right: El acuerdo puso fin a la huelga.
pitfalls.why: Almost. It is *poner fin a*, never *de*.
Almost. *Dar comienzo* is for ceremonies and papers. With friends at the table, use *empezar*.

personal: Open or close an imaginary meeting the formal way: *Doy comienzo a la sesión.* or *Pongo fin a esta reunión.*
